Technical Project Manager / IT Infrastructure Engineer

Nebius · Paris

Technical Project Manager / IT Infrastructure Engineer at Nebius. Paris. Apply for this Technical Project Manager / IT Infrastructure Engineer opportunity through the original employer or job source.

Job Description

&lt;div class="content-intro"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About Nebius:&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;We give you the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies in data operations, cloud computing and infrastructure management. As global data center operations grow, there will be ample opportunities for career progression. Working in the data center directly impacts performance, customer satisfaction and efficiency, with the opportunity to contribute to new data center projects.You’ll collaborate with experts in AI data center development and operations, gaining insights from leaders in the field. This environment fosters innovation, and allows you to work on solutions that exceed industry standards in design and deployment.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;h2 id="The-role" data-local-id="845b3f7d-a021-479c-aa55-b946aa3389b1" data-renderer-start-pos="114"&gt;The role&lt;/h2&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="124" data-local-id="c3784de0-1b95-4285-ab3f-c07450356948"&gt;We are looking for a &lt;strong data-renderer-mark="true"&gt;Technical Project Manager&lt;/strong&gt; to join our team and manage different projects and changes in data center. You will work with modern GPU clusters, responsible for execution of projects around IT infrastructure and equipment: GPU servers, high-speed network, compute and storage systems. Acting as a key link between the stakeholders, project and technical teams, you will drive operational activities across your responsibility area.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="613" data-local-id="9897594f-2d1a-4d09-93b3-8fd80da363b0"&gt;&lt;strong data-renderer-mark="true"&gt;Your responsibilities will include: &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;ul class="ak-ul" data-local-id="e3a2c2e6-8648-48f2-aef9-187470cf33ec" data-indent-level="1"&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="653" data-local-id="60cd0a76-aadb-44ad-96ed-a1f92b696179"&gt;Management and delivery of IT infrastructure projects, change requests in data centers&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="743" data-local-id="5c2a2e3f-7fcf-46b6-a7b1-95f1651a601d"&gt;Proactively identify and manage resolution of technical and operational issues&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="825" data-local-id="f94b2944354f"&gt;Managing risks and dependencies in live environments&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="881" data-local-id="68094a32-7f08-44d0-aae7-f93adfe06c32"&gt;Maintain clear operational documentation, including plans, risk logs, and issue trackers.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="974" data-local-id="50f5d5a9-1751-442c-90de-b8b209886703"&gt;Lead communication with all stakeholders: provide regular progress updates, escalate blockers, and manage expectations.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1097" data-local-id="c64ebb2d1fea"&gt;Lead meetings and technical discussions with a focus on decision-making, clear next steps, and timely execution.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1213" data-local-id="9589dd22-f4de-4a43-9b6d-7dc24a6636d5"&gt;Collaborate with cross-functional teams.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1257" data-local-id="26170b4aa5a1"&gt;Engage directly with data center engineers, vendors, and operations teams.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1335" data-local-id="af76dfff-7bc3-4cf4-aaa9-3d31d4bdae90"&gt;Participate in related project tasks, including automation, process improvements, and design support as needed.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1450" data-local-id="b386c094-8ef9-41e7-add4-39e703e9984c"&gt;&lt;strong data-renderer-mark="true"&gt;We expect you to have:&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;ul class="ak-ul" data-local-id="fca567b4-a4e9-4adb-9f5f-d209b3fffb73" data-indent-level="1"&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1476" data-local-id="a8e5c3a7-4d71-4b8b-b768-f686faa187a1"&gt;Proven experience in data center infrastructure operations, preferably in high-performance or AI-oriented environments.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1599" data-local-id="a4277080-698b-4554-a6dc-eab3082ce1ff"&gt;Solid understanding of data center design and operations: racking, cabling, power planning, cooling considerations.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1718" data-local-id="0234e8d6-3ab3-4d90-b6e5-11858eb906fe"&gt;Hands on experience working with IT hardware in data centers.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1784" data-local-id="9f393a5b55ed"&gt;Be comfortable in data center environments and during live operations.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1858" data-local-id="5ccbedaa-e242-4710-9633-dcce11fd4234"&gt;Experience in project delivery, team management, cross team collaboration&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1935" data-local-id="b95940e3-29f3-4025-b128-e8589f2cf740"&gt;Strong problem-solving skills; ability to troubleshoot technical and workflow issues in an IT stack.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2039" data-local-id="6ac48dcb-a82f-4609-b24c-5a12c0350280"&gt;Ability to document processes, maintain tracking systems, and produce clear deployment reports.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2138" data-local-id="0f8a87bf-01c2-43d3-acb4-5c428d76db9d"&gt;Activity, responsibility and purposefulness&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2185" data-local-id="72bbff00-8681-4746-9ca4-4ae1ea03cfa3"&gt;Ready for occasional business trips&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2224" data-local-id="420f9a0c-ab5b-4728-8f12-bdd34bbc7193"&gt;&lt;strong data-renderer-mark="true"&gt;It will be an added bonus if you have:&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2367" data-local-id="49b0921e20d9"&gt;Relevant technical certifications &lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2405" data-local-id="cb26b55a-c667-4e4d-a5c8-0f55bc340994"&gt;In depth technical knowledge of GPU servers, compute nodes, high-speed networking&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt;&lt;div class="content-conclusion"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Benefits & Perks:&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;ul&gt; &lt;li&gt;Competitive compensation&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Career growth and learning opportunities&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Flexibility and ownership&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Collaborative and innovative culture&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;International environment and talented teams&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What's it like to work at Nebius:&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI &lt;/p&gt;
